title: Army formations
requirement: arrange troops into lines, wedges, squares or loose skirmish groups.

title: Morale
requirement: isolated or badly damaged squads can retreat or surrender.

title: Cover
requirement: rocks, ruins and buildings reduce incoming ranged damage.

title: Cavalry charges
requirement: build impact through movement, with pikes stopping the charge.

title: Capturable siege engines
requirement: defeat their crews and claim the equipment.

title: Ambush orders
requirement: conceal troops and set conditions for revealing them.
